_note: Every value is extracted from a claim quote by compute.py, or computed here from values so extracted.

acres.basis: acres of Disaster City's mock community

participants.basis: a floor, printed with more than

prize_pool_m.basis: millions of dollars in cash prizes, a floor, printed with more than

systems_prize_m.basis: RoboScout's Systems prize and the grand prize, millions of dollars

data_prize_m.basis: Disruptors' Data prize, millions of dollars

winners_m.basis: systems_prize_m + data_prize_m, never set against the pool

finals_days.basis: inclusive days from the first to the last day of the finals

created_year.basis: the year DARPA created the challenge

triagex_close_day.basis: November day the TRIAGE-X topic closes

plate_usd.basis: drawing unit, one brass plate stands for this many dollars, a rule not a measurement

plates_pool.basis: prize_pool_m * 1e6 / plate_usd, the floor of the purse in plates, the stack runs off the frame because the pool is more than

close_after_finals_days.basis: triagex_close_day - finals_end_day, days the topic stays open after the finals end
